units.source_text: 贺茂祭之日，佛前供葵花，人都插葵花。

en.t: On the day of the Kamo Festival, mallow flowers were offered before the Buddha, and everyone wore mallow flowers.
In Japanese, the word “aoi,” meaning mallow, sounds like “au hi,” the day of meeting.
A day of meeting means a day when a man and a woman come together.

units.source_text: 下文说“名字都忘记了”，意思是说久不和此女相会。

en.t: When the later text says that he has even forgotten her name, it means that he has not met this woman for a long time.

units.source_text: 此女答诗“净水已生萍”，亦久不承宠之意。

en.t: The woman’s reply poem, “duckweed has already grown on the clear water,” also means that she has long been out of favor.
